headline: vend_to_svid_ms: parent sends POST /delegations (t0) -> child's first Workload API answer holding the new X.509-SVID received (t3)
harness: src/experiments/vend_to_svid.py (with the parentsim modes vend-timed and svid-wait)

code.state: uncommitted working tree at run time

command: cd src/experiments && CLUSTER_NAME=nhi-lab KUBECTX=kind-bench-v2s TRUST_DOMAIN=lab.local uv run python3 vend_to_svid.py --trials 50

bring_up: make vend-to-svid KIND_CLUSTER=bench-v2s VEND_SVID_TRIALS=2 (deploys policy engine, vending service and fixtures; 2-trial smoke, not kept)

config_changes_on_this_cluster_only.change: added `audit_log_enabled = true` to the server block of the live spire-server ConfigMap, then restarted the StatefulSet (data on a PVC, so entries and CA kept)
config_changes_on_this_cluster_only.why: at the configured log_level INFO the server logs nothing per request; the audit log records every API call (BatchCreateEntry, SyncAuthorizedEntries, BatchNewX509SVID, BatchDeleteEntry)
config_changes_on_this_cluster_only.note: the run was started without make, because make vend-to-svid re-applies the repository's SPIRE ConfigMap (entries -> spire-agent -> spire-server)

harness_differences_from_run_2: run 1 predates --jitter-s; its CSV has no pre_trial_jitter_ms or phase_since_child_agent_sync_ms columns. The phase figures below were computed afterwards from this run's logs/spire-server files.
